I received the following email from Amazon. We sell with them, but when I login to Seller Central and look at ALL inventory... I can't find any products with excess inventory. In fact, the all inventory section show only ONE product has ANY inventory right now. And I'm about to send more so it can keep being FBA. All of our other products did not sell well on Amazon, so we discounted them and stopped sending inventory and it shows them all as OUT OF STOCK so how can we have excess levels of inventory?????... please help me understand their email below:

Hello,

We noticed you have a number of ASIN(s) that have excess levels of inventory. We are reaching out to inform you about multiple options to improve your Unit Sales on your aged and/or excess inventory in Amazon Fulfillment Centers. Our goal is to help you increase the sales on this excess inventory:
X0035L3SLN, X0031LB38X

We encourage you to take Amazon recommended actions such as Create Outlet deals, Sponsor Products Ad, to improve sell through of this excess inventory and potentially reduce your chances of incurring aged inventory fee.

Outlet deals
Amazon Outlet is a great place for customers to shop for overstock deals, which offers a selection of items, such as electronics, toys, beauty, and kitchen.
Create Outlet Deal Today!

Sponsored Product Ads
Sponsored Products is a cost-per-click advertising solution that provides advertisers with a foundation of controls and visibility to help get their individual products discovered, and help generate sales from traffic sources in the Amazon store and on select premium apps and websites.
Create Sponsored Products Ad Today!

We encourage you to view and execute ASIN level sell through recommendation on FBA Inventory page.

Thank you,
The Fulfillment by Amazon team

Initial situation: Construction Company

The innovation department of a German construction company asked us to identify and validate a new opportunity in the field of automation and process optimization for the construction site as a potential venture case.

Case study:

Discovery

Identify two relevant industry trend fields that can be relevant for this project. Additionally, explain your approach, particularly how you (would) utilized AI for the search of the trends fields and which prompts you used.

Choose one of the trend fields and explain your reasoning. Identify a specific opportunity within that trend field. For inspiration, review 5-10 startups operating in that space.

Validation (Please do this according to Desirability, Feasibility and Viability)

Create a project plan (including timelines and staffing) for a 3-month validation and briefly explain the key steps and experiments you would conduct.

What potential outputs (deliverables) can be generated after such a validation? When and how (with which metrics) would you evaluate these outputs - from the client's perspective?

When considering your opportunity, what could be a knockout criterion? How would you deal with it if it leads to a falsification of the business model?

The client is validating a business opportunity for the first time and insists on a build case, even though you’ve recognized it doesn’t make sense during the validation process. How do you handle this?

You have a challenging with a senior member of hy about your pitch presentation and receive many inputs and feedback what can be improved in the presentation. It is 7pm and the presentation is due the next day at noon. How do you react? (no slide needed for this question)

 How will AI influence the business model?



hy-Offering

We are constantly trying to develop new offerings for our clients. One offering could be the application or automation of venture validation processes through AI. What opportunity would you have for an offering within the validation process? How would you outline and set up the new offering? How would you bring the new AI offering designed for the validation process to potential clients?

Please outline in one slide your professional network.

Which specific AI tools did you use to work on the case and why?

Imagine that you had mastered all available AI tools, how would you have approached the case?
